_description: Fired when a visitor views a page
_note: The bare-minimum event. `url` and `referrer` are already envelope fields, so they aren't repeated here. Everything below is only readable client-side — anything derivable from HTTP headers (User-Agent, Accept-Language) lives on the envelope instead.
document_language_description: The page's own declared language (document.documentElement.lang), distinct from the visitor's browser locale
